reviews.text: Dr. Viktoria Pugnetti was truly an angel. For how sad this day was, she was so patient and loving and made sure we knew what was happening every step of the way - making us feel at peace. We never felt rushed or like this was a transaction. I cannot recommend her enough and this amazing company. Thank you so much for taking the best care of our sweet Bill Murray!

Hi Jen,

Thank you for your outstanding review of our services!  Take care and know that we're thinking of you!

The staff here at All About Restful Pets,
With love and sympathy.

I cannot thank Dr. Pugnetti enough. She took so much time with us. My girl was so comfortable and literally left this world snoring away. The compassion we received was beyond expectations. I am forever grateful! ❤️

It is not easy writing this review since my Cocker Spaniel Riley had to be put to sleep not even 2 weeks ago on September 17, 2026 but he was 14 plus years old and his health was failing. Dr. Gina Sarnelli was wonderful. She was very compassionite, asked a lot about Riley while he had snuggled up against her and he recived a lot of rubs & petting. There was NO time limit, so to speak, and everything was explained step by step. When the time had come she asked if I would want to leave the room which I did not do.
When Riley had passed she wrapped him in 2 or 3 small blankets and she carried him to the front door and then asked if I would like to carry him to the car which I greatly appreciated.
Seeing the care that Dr. Sarnelli showed meant a lot and in a way helped me knowing I had done the right thing for "my little buddy" to move on..
Dr Sarnelli was exceptionally kind and gentle.  I always knew when the time came, I wanted my baby to be able to go peacefully at home. And I’m glad I could give that to him.

I had reached out to Restful Pets in need of euthanasia service for my cat, and not only did they explain things and helped with the scheduling, but overall were fantastic. Especially due to being in a service area outside of most others, they were able to come out quickly and charged reasonable for all services.

From the customer service to the doctor that visited, we had a much easier time coming to terms with and going through the process. I could not recommend them enough if you are looking for a similar service.

From the receptionist to the vet, this company only knows compassionate care.
Dr. Pugnetti was an angel in scrubs. She was so kind and gentle towards our buddy, Bamboo and made sure we were all well informed with the process of letting our pet go. Every moment was carefully planned and we were provided with all the time we needed to grieve. Seeing how tenderly she cared for our fur baby really eased the transition for us. I can't thank her and the entire company for the comfort they provide.
Victoria was wonderful. She helped me through one of the most difficult times in my life. She Treated my missy like she was her own. I can't express how wonderful Victoria was.

My sweet Kota girl, went down & couldn’t get back up.
It was a weekend & I reached out to over 10 places (via text, because I couldn’t get myself to call) everyone I called couldn’t get to us until 2-3 days especially with it being a holiday weekend.

Dr. Viktoria Pugnetti came to our home very compassionate and understanding of what we had to do, with my little kids around, she explained the entire process to me in a way the kids would also understand.

Forever grateful to come across their page, even though I wish I never had to. But in life it all comes a time, and I’m thankful we were able to do it in the comfort of our home and make this process so much easier on my first child.

I also requested not get her ashes back, so they are spreading her somewhere in Tucson for me. And they have followed up with a card in the mail plus an email.

Extremely thankful!
This was the most compassionate caring experience we have when having to say goodbye to our loving ROCK STAR (Ebony) thank you for being so caring .

At an absolutely devastating time, the whole team at All About Restful Pets was a blessing. From the first compassionate calming phone call to the moment we said goodbye to our sweet LuDog for the last time, every member of their team was unfailingly kind and patient. Thank you all.

If you are debating to call or to get an appointment, please do it. These Vets are angels that will take very good care of your fur babies through it all. Highly recommend always. Thank you again for taking care of my Ali Bubba. He really was a beautiful boy.

I would give them 15 stars if possible. Every interaction I had during this incredibly difficult time was met with kindness and empathy. I am convinced that Dr Pugnetti is truly an angel. She was able to clearly explain every step, match the speed at which we were comfortable with, and most importantly treated my Snickerdoodle like he was her own fur baby. She made sure he was comfortable the entire time, focused on reducing any anxiety and ensured that his goodbye was pain free and peaceful. Considering how impossibly hard that day was, she was the reason he got the goodbye he deserved and helped me handle the heartbreak afterwards.

We are incredibly grateful to Restful Pets for the compassion and care they showed our family during one of the most heartbreaking moments we’ve ever experienced. She assisted us in saying goodbye to our big boy, Clifford, and was incredibly patient, empathetic, and gentle throughout the entire process.

She treated Clifford with such kindness and dignity, and she gave us the time and space we needed to say goodbye. Her calm and compassionate presence made an unbearable moment a little easier.

Thank you, Restful Pets, for taking such beautiful care of our Clifford and our family. We will always be grateful❤️

Heartfelt Review

I just wanted to take a moment to write about this company and the incredible care they provided during one of the most difficult times for our family.

They went above and beyond to make an extremely painful experience a little easier. Saying goodbye to our dog and family member of 13 years, Little Ann, was heartbreaking, but their compassion and professionalism made a tremendous difference.

She was incredibly patient and compassionate with Little Ann and with us. She explained every step of what was happening and what we could expect, which helped us feel more comfortable during such a difficult time. Most importantly, she made sure Little Ann was comfortable and would not feel anything as she peacefully passed.

We are incredibly grateful for the kindness, patience, and dignity they showed our beloved Little Ann and our family.

Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for making such a heartbreaking moment a little more peaceful. We will never forget the compassion you showed us and Little Ann. ❤️🐾

My boy Toulouse has been dealing with back pain and temperament issues. Ever since he started to see Dr. Asadorian, he has been getting better. He does so well with his physical therapy, all he needs is good motivation. Although he protests his needles, Dr Asadorian is so patient and loving towards him. She has done a lot of work for him, I appreciate all that she has done!
Dr. Gina Sarnelli was wonderful with my precious Roxy. She showed care and kindness towards both my beloved pet and me. I was able to spend as much time as I needed to say goodbye.

Our sweet 15 year old dog took a turn for the worse on a Friday, and we wrestled with the decision of whether to rush and have her  put down at her vet by 2 pm Saturday, or schedule euthanasia at home. I had never done euthanasia at home and it seemed like the best way to go. All About Restful Pets was recommended to me by another pet euthanasia provider that was booked for the weekend, and I am so glad we were able to use them. Dr Pugnetti arrived at our house Sunday morning and handled the situation with both professionalism and sincere compassion. Our children were home with us, and she explained everything in just enough detail beforehand and during the process. The best way I can describe it is a  gentle and peaceful experience. I did not feel like our sweet girl suffered at all, and Dr Pugnetti was so patient while we cried, prayed with her, and loved on our girl one last time. It was a wonderful experience for such a sad occasion, and I am so glad we chose AARP to provide this for our pet.

Sorry for not telling you sooner.. You know how much it hurts to lose a PUP.
I had to put Mysti down last Wednesday night... got to a point she was having trouble just to stand up, and when I got her up she would have trouble breathing, had that dry cough. and would go back down gasping for air...
All day Wednesday I made her as comfortable as possible, no breathing attacks, no hacking.. lot's of cookies and treats, it was a good day..........
Wednesday night around 9p.m. the vet. came and did her thing...
Dr. Gena was very loving and compassionate, did not rush the process, and explained everything, She got along with Mysti, no problems at all.. even got a couple of puppy kisses.
She petted her for quite a while, more treats... Mysti was not antsy at all, just went to sleep with no problems at all.
I can only be thankful for having that sweet little gal for as long as I did.
God Bless MYSTI, and thank you Dr. Gena for putting my PUP to rest.!!!
This was the most peaceful experience. It can be as much or private as you want it to be. What a great service.

We loved our beloved Hank and after a terrible diagnosis of osteosarcoma we knew taking him to a new a stressful vets office just did not feel right for his last moment. Shelley was extremely helpful and Dr. Pugnetti knew exactly weand our extremely anxious 13 year old puppy needed. Love, praise, compassion in one of the worst times of our lives. I’m thankful for them for making our sons last moments peaceful and happy in his own home.

We sadly had to put down our two almost 13 year old labs a few weeks ago. One had a large mass in his gut and the other had lymphoma. All About Restful Pets worked with us on finding the right day and time for us to say goodbye, respecting our need for a bit more time from when we originally scheduled and supporting us through the difficult decision process on whether to euthanize them together or not. When they did come to our house, they were so compassionate and respectful. The vet explained everything step by step, provided us the time and space to say goodbye to each of our beloved furry babies. I would highly recommend their service. They allowed us to manage this difficult time with our dogs in our home together without the discomfort of going to a vet's office.

Dr. Viktoria Pugnetti was amazing. From the moment she got to the house she brought a sense of calm to the unfortunate reason she was there. She explained everything that was going to happen before she started and moved at the pace we were comfortable with. She realized that we were losing a very loved member of the family and worked with compassion. I highly recommend this place!

Hi Paula,

Thank you for trusting All About Restful Pets and for your wonderful review.  Sending you comfort and healing as you cherish the beautiful memories you shared together.

May time heal your heart and memories comfort your soul.

From the team here at All About Restful Pets!

"I cannot thank Dr. Pugnetti enough for the incredible kindness, compassion, and respect she showed during one of the hardest days of my life. Saying goodbye to my beloved Coco was heartbreaking, but Dr. Pugnetti brought so much peace, warmth, and comfort into our home. She gently guided us through every step of the process, making sure Coco was completely painless, calm, and surrounded by love. Her gentle soul and compassionate care truly softened our grief. Dr. Pugnetti is an absolute gift, and I am forever grateful for the beautiful, dignified farewell she gave to my sweet Coco." I highly recommend All About Restful Pets.

It's never easy to say goodbye, but the team at Restful Pets was nothing but helpful, kind, and compassionate. Dr. Pugnetti explained every step of the process and ensured my husband and I were ready to proceed each time, included our entire furry family, and ensured our girl had a comfortable, peaceful end of life surrounded by her pack. I highly recommend their services to anyone in need.

Dr. Pugnetti was absolutely amazing. I scheduled at home euthanasia for my 19 year old cat and Dr. Pugnetti provided such a warm, nice experience for such a difficult time. She cried with me and was so wonderful to my cat. I highly recommend Restful Pets.

Dr. Sarah and Shelley are wonderful.  My pets are my other babies and I found comfort in being able to have Dr. Sarah provide acupuncture and hospice care to our senior " big" boy Crash. We are grateful to have 16.5 yrs with him and allow him to have comfort in his remaining time. Especially greatful that Dr. Sarah was there for his final moments. Saying goodbye is hard, but Dr. Sarah helped us navigate this process.

Dr. Gina Sarnelli was super helpful and gentle with our Luna and we were not rushed during the process, I highly recommend their services, prices are very decent and the overall compassion we felt from the team made the process and aftercare easier for us, thank you so much!

My baby boy Dexter, my OG, my old man, was 14 1/2 years old. He was diagnosed with failing kidneys and as much as I wanted to keep him with me every last breath of his life and mine, he was starting to suffer and suffer a lot more. I made the decision to let him go peacefully and scheduled an appointment on Monday with Dr. Pugnetti. I was dreading the appointment, of course, but she was really amazing at putting us both at ease as much as possible when she arrived. She explained the entire process as we got Dex settled into his final bed, and let us know that she would do everything under the speed in which we wanted it. Right after the first shot, I gave him melted Reese‘s peanut butter cups, which was so much fun to watch him devour and love, the one and only time in his life he tasted chocolate. Probably within a minute of him finishing, he fell asleep. She let us talk to him and say anything else we wanted as she prepared the last dose, which would stop his heart. It happened so quickly, he fell into his last deep sleep without any reaction and then he was gone. It was sad and devastating, but so beautiful how easily the pain slipped away from him.

We decided to keep him in his bed instead of the stretcher, so she helped me carefully wrap him up inside, and we carried him out to her vehicle together. She was so kind and promised me to treat Dexter like her family during all of this. I desperately appreciate that my beautiful friend was treated so well by the incredible Dr Pugnetti.

This wasn’t my first experience with at home euthanasia, we had to put my spouses dog down a few years ago. I don’t remember which company we used, but they were sitting there trying to sell us add-on Services before they even got started. It was horrible and not a good experience, also they didn’t administer medication in the same way and that dog had a strange reaction at the end. Nothing like that happened here, it was a tragically good experience from beginning to end.

I got nothing in exchange for this post, they never even mentioned a review. But they did such a beautiful job at such a sad experience. I wanted everyone to know they can put their trust in them for their babies last moments, and your last moments with them.

I lost my baby boy, my old man, my best friend June 1st. I had only recently learned about at home euthenasia being an option and this was my first experience. The whole process while still incredibly sad and painful was so much more peaceful than sitting in a vet room then having to drive home alone. I was treated with great care and compassion and I will be keeping these guys in my pet files should I find myself in this situation again in the future. I have also been telling my friends about the option for at home and recommending Restful Pets from here on out

Dr. Pugnetti was wonderful and caring during the entire process. She made us feel like she loved our dog and would care for him well. As heartbreaking as it was to put down our very good boy, she made sure that he was free from pain while we said our goodbyes. It was a very calm and peaceful way to send our beloved pet to the rainbow bridge. Thank you Dr. Pugnetti for your compassionate care.

Big thanks to Restful Pets for helping our family during our beloved Roxy sudden pasing. Everything flowed with ease from making the appointment online to the cremation and pick up of my dog's Ashes. Everyone was nice and respectful. I was grateful and amazed by the quick and a constant communication from Restful Pets as we waited for our appointment. I appreciate the grace gentleness the used in caring for our beloved.
Thank you.

Our beloved sheltie had a turn for the worst on a Sunday moring.  We knew it was time, and didn't want her to suffer any further.  We contacted All About Restful Pets, and the person who answered the phone was so very understanding and sensitive to our need for someone to come soon.  Dr Pugnetti arrived just a couple hours later and showed the utmost care and concern for our baby girl and our breaking hearts.  She explained everything she was going to do prior to starting anything, then explained again while she was helping our suffering girl get relief and drift away.  She loved on our baby and was so gentle with her.  She was very caring and kind with us, and she provided us with a sweet dog print and key chain with some of our baby's fur in it so we could remember her.  She gave us as much time as we wanted to say our goodbyes, and let us know she was always available if we needed her afterwards with the full understanding of how difficult it is to go through saying goodbye.  We are so glad we chose to make our girl's last moments peaceful ones.  It has really helped us in our grief to know that she was provided the best of care to the very end.

The veterinarian who came to our home was absolutely wonderful. She was compassionate, patient, and empathetic throughout the entire experience. We had our children and our other dog present, and she handled everything masterfully. She was calm, thoughtful, and answered our children's questions with kindness and gentleness. Saying goodbye is never easy, but the veterinarian who cared for Ranger also cared for all of us. This was my first experience with in-home euthanasia, and if I ever have to make this difficult decision again, I would choose this veterinarian every time.

One of the hardest decisions to make is having to put your fur baby down. Restful Pets came highly recommended. From the start there was great communication leading right up to the moment Dr Pugnetti arrived whom I will forever be grateful for her compassion, soft voice, kind spirit and love for animals. She walked my brother and I through the whole process step by step. She took care of our “old man” Sox as if he was her own. She took the time to answer all questions and genuinely talked with us about Sox and what kind of dog he was his likes, mishap's, favorite toys, funny stories etc. I couldn’t have asked for a more peaceful experience during a truly difficult time.  Thank you Dr Pugnetti you truly are a blessing!

Dr. Pugnetti came to our home recently to give us the most beautiful goodbye to one of our older dogs. Every aspect of her visit felt like a blessing at the hardest time. We still talk about how grateful we are. I can't speak highly enough!

Saying goodbye to our beloved baby was one of the most difficult moments our family has ever faced, but Dr. Pugnetti made the experience peaceful and compassionate.
From the moment Dr. Pugnetti arrived at our home, we felt supported, cared for, and never rushed. She treated our dog with incredible gentleness, dignity, and respect, while also showing genuine empathy for our family during such a heartbreaking time.
Being able to say goodbye in the comfort and familiarity of our home made all the difference. Dr. Pugnetti patiently explained each step of the process, answered our questions with kindness, and gave us the time and space we needed to share our final moments together.
We are deeply grateful for the compassion and professionalism Dr. Pugnetti showed during one of life's hardest goodbyes. Her care helped turn an incredibly painful experience into one filled with love, peace, and dignity.
Thank you, Dr. Pugnetti, for helping our beloved sweet girl cross the rainbow bridge with such grace and kindness. We will never forget your support during this difficult time.

Dr. Pugnetti and staff provided the absolute best experience one could have. When having to say goodbye to their beloved best friend.  Caring, compassionate, empathetic, supportive, and my buddy was so relaxed and comfortable in his last moments...I would never chose another way to say goodbye.  Thank you and bless you all!

Can't say enough good things about this company and the staff. From the respectful communication getting the appointment logistics set up to the loving presence of Dr. Pugnetti in our home and toward our dog kids... we are so grateful! We also appreciated the selection of memorabilia Restful Pets had to offer. Sharing a photo of our sweet little girl, resting her head on our gentle boy who had passed just a few moments before. The service and kindness Restful Pets provided offered comfort and peace during a difficult time.

Shelley was the first person I spoke to when having to make this most difficult, almost impossible decision. She was so kind and supportive as I was trying to navigate through it. On the day of, Dr. Sarnellli arrived and she was exactly the right person to assist us with one of the most painful moments in our lives. Her compassion, communication, kindness and patience made us feel more comfortable in that very difficult time. She treated Stella like she’d known and loved her just as we did. I am forever grateful for her compassion.

I was referred to All About Restful Pets when a friend knew we were struggling with our aged dog to determine if we had more time with her and if she was in a lot of pain. While we thought she was in pain due to her constant panting and no longer wanting to be petted or held, we needed confirmation before making a very hard decision. The vet was very honest with us on her visit. She took her time with our girl and us. Giving us plenty of time to ask questions, as well as explaining the very humane procedure you would ever want with your furry animal. When it was time to let our girl go their process was peaceful and provided us with the exact amount of closure. There are not enough amazing words I can say about All About Restful Pets.

Restful Pets did a wonderful job helping our family navigate through a sad and difficult moment. From the first phone call, to Dr. Gina administering the medication to our beloved pup, we were consistently treated with kindness, compassion, and understanding. I highly recommend Restful Pets and am grateful to them for helping ease our dog’s transition.

I am so thankful I found All About Restful Pets. Dr. Pugnetti was compassionate, I can tell she really cares about animals. She made an absolutely heartbreaking experience very peaceful. Thank you from the bottom of my heart, I am so glad I trusted my Hazie with you 💕

I can't say enough about the care and compassion Dr. Gina Sarnelli and Restful Pets showed us during a very difficult and sad time. Dr. Gina gave us all the time we needed to say goodbye to Sophie, she actually had me smiling a little as she got me talking about Sophie which brought up a ton of good memories.
They made a very tough time a little bit easier.

We had Dr. P help with our dog. She was fantastic! She sat with him for 10 - 15 minutes calming him and telling us the process. She explained each step and made sure we we all ok before proceeding. Her manner made a crappy day much less painful. I will surely use their service again.

I had to make a very tough decision having to put my 10 year old German Shepherd Sadie to sleep after her rapidly declining overall health.  I was pleased with the experience I had when the Vet from All About Restful Pets showed up at my home.  She showed compassion and explained the entire process step by step. I was given all the time I needed for my final goodbye and did not feel rushed at all.  I was able to kiss her forehead countless times and hold her paw while looking into her eyes so she knew I would remain at her side during her final breath.  The process was very peaceful and was glad I made the decision to have Sadie spend her final moments in the comfort of her home.  I highly recommend All About Restful Pets when the decision has to be made to have a beloved pet put to rest

Hi Amy,

Thank you for your wonderful review and for posting the cutest picture.

We will never forget the sweet faces of those we love.

From all of us here at All About Restful Pets,

Our deepest sympathy!

This was one of the hardest decisions I’ve ever had to make.

My dog, Georgie, had been sick for several weeks, and what we initially thought were G/I issues turned out to be terminal cancer. I received the news in the ER the day before, but by the next day it was clear how quickly it was progressing and how much it had weakened him.

I was fortunate to be able to schedule an appointment that same day, despite it being a Sunday on a holiday weekend. As heartbreaking as it was, I knew I didn’t want him to suffer any longer.

Dr. Falcone was the kindest and most compassionate person I could have hoped for during such a difficult time. She took the time to carefully explain every step of the process, answered my questions with patience and empathy, and treated Georgie with incredible care.

I don’t know how she does this work every day, but I am so grateful that she does. I cried through the entire appointment, yet she remained gentle, reassuring, and patient. Because of her, Georgie was able to pass peacefully at home on his couch.

For one of the most painful moments of my life, I cannot express how grateful I am for the compassion, professionalism, and humanity Dr. Falcone showed us. She made an impossible day a little bit easier, and I will always be thankful for that.

Dr Victoria Pugnetti was very kind compassionate and thoughtful  not only for my loved family pet Thumper who needed comfort but for all family present. She was so loving and considerate, yet professional and educative. I have had this company out a couple times now and highly recommend their services. This experience is never a fun one but they made it comfortable with exceptional support and always timely service.

When the time came to say goodbye to our beloved Lulu Belle, our 17 year old, 2 pound Yorkie, we could not have asked for a better experience than the one Dr. Gina provided through Restful Pets.

What stood out most was her ability to truly read the room. She understood that while we were heartbroken, we did not need someone who would make the sadness heavier. Instead, she met us exactly where we were. She shared smiles and laughter as we told stories about Lulu Belle, and when the difficult moments came, she gave us the space and support we needed.

Dr. Gina never rushed us. She patiently explained each step, answered every question, and allowed us all the time we needed to say goodbye in our own way. Her compassion felt genuine and natural. She struck the perfect balance between professionalism and warmth during one of the hardest moments a pet owner can face.

Lulu Belle was a tiny 2 pound Yorkie who gave us 17 wonderful years, and saying goodbye was incredibly difficult. Dr. Gina helped make that final gift of love as peaceful and dignified as possible.

We will always be grateful for the care she showed both Lulu Belle and our family. Thank you, Dr. Gina.

We recently had to say goodbye to our almost 16-year-old pit mix,  Ruka, and Restful Pets helped us create the most beautiful at-home goodbye we could have asked for.

Dr. Pugnetti was thoughtful, professional, compassionate, and genuinely made an incredibly emotional day feel peaceful, loving, and dignified. We are so grateful for the care, kindness, and presence she brought into our home during such a tender moment.

We can not say enough about Restful Pets, when others had to turn us down in our time of need All About Restful Pets was able to help us through a very difficult time. Dr. Viktoria Pugnetti arrived and was one of the most compassionate and caring people we had ever met. You could immediately tell that Viktoria truly cared about not only about our fur-baby but also about my wife and me. She took her time to explain the process and did not rush us at all. Our dog took to her instantly and felt comfortable with her. Her careful handling of our pup, even after he had passed, showed her true love in helping pets cross-over peacefully and comfortably.
I highly recommend All About Restful Pets and in particular Dr. Pugnetti.
We are grateful for the Respectful and Compassionate manner Dr Pugnetti helped our beloved kitty cross the Rainbow Bride. 🌈 💔

I can't thank or recommend All About Restful Pets enough. While it's taken me 3 weeks to even write about it; the event itself was absolutely perfect. I loved my boy more than anything I've had and spent an amazing 20 years with White Sox, but he was tough, hated going to the Vet, and I didn't want his last moments to be in vane.

Dr. Falcone was sympathetic and understanding to our concerns.  She listened to us and then described the process in great detail including certain scenarios that could play out.  Due to the teams help in preparing, our boy White Sox went in peace.  He never even had to raise his blood pressure and went in peace.

I would absolutely use All About Restful Pets again and would refer them to anyone I know. Thank you Dr. Falcone and Team.

It was a horrible day, but Dr. Pugnetti was amazing and so caring and understanding.  I absolutely recommend this company and specifically Dr. Pugnetti.  She was so careful with my dog and explained the process so we knew exactly how it would proceed.

Dr Sarnelli was so compassionate and understanding of my little Luna who was passing on. And also, for my other cat, JoJo, who was feeling the change. She put me at ease during this stressful time. Restful Pets is the perfect name for their service. I highly recommend their Service for this special time with our pets.

We are very happy with our choice of going with Restful Pets to lead us through the process of saying goodbye to our best girl, Bailey.

Dr. Pugnetti was very helpful with explaining the process fully to us before getting started. She was so kind and compassionate and really helped us feel as comfortable as possible during a really hard time for us.

Their team was also very accommodating as we originally booked a later evening time slot but asked if we could adjust due to our pup being in pain.

Bailey was not a fan of the vet so it was very important to us to do this in the comfort of our home, surrounded by all of her favorite people, including our younger dog / her little brother, Zeus. He was able to be next to her the entire time and Dr. Pugnetti shared that she thought he understood what was happening which was also important to us.

It was truly one of the hardest days and she really helped us through it. We are so glad to have her paw print and the little keychain with fur in it that Dr. Pugnetti surprised us with. We will forever be grateful to Dr. Pugnetti and her kindness on this day.

I cannot recommend Restful Pets enough. Dr. Pugnetti is an absolute treasure. The care and compassion she showed me and my pup Frankie was truly a blessing. Making the decision to put Frankie to sleep was difficult and emotional. Witnessing his passing, while equally difficult and emotional, was made infinitely easier by Dr. Pugnetti's presence and guidance. I am eternally grateful for this experience. Thank you for providing a service that allows pets to pass with dignity in their own home.
They took such care and compassion during my cat's final moments.

It’s taken me some time to be able to write this, but I am deeply grateful for Restful Pets and Dr. Gina Sarnelli. They helped us through one of the hardest moments of our lives with compassion, gentleness, and genuine care.

We had to say goodbye to our beloved Goldendoodle due to a neurological condition, and Dr. Gina made her passing peaceful and dignified. She was incredibly kind and supportive, guiding us through each step and giving us the space and time we needed as we held our girl and spoke to her. She helped us reflect on her happiest moments, the adventures, the quirks, and all the love she brought into our home.

What could have been an unbearable day became a sweet, meaningful sendoff. I will always be thankful for the comfort Dr. Gina brought to our family and for the tenderness she showed during our girl’s journey to the rainbow bridge.

Dr. Pugnetti was so helpful in guiding my family through making the decision to put our sweet 17 year old Ice to rest. The day I scheduled the appointment we were all so confused and unsure, and she let us know we could just have a palliative care appointment that day and call her back if needed when we were ready. The next day my soul dog let me know it was time, and I sent Dr. Pugnetti a message. She reserved a 2 hour block in her day just in case I needed it, and I am truly so so grateful for that because to watch him suffer any longer would have been so difficult. I am eternally grateful to the Restful Pets crew. Shelly responded to all my messages so quickly, Bonnie answered my initial call when I was inquiring about their services and immediately sent me a text message with her scheduling link. And Dr. Pugnetti walked us through the whole process to remind us that this wouldn't be painful, it would be peaceful. Thank you guys so much for all your help during such a hard time.

I would like to thank the entire staff at Restful Pets for making a very difficult day a little bit better. Unfortunately, our 11-year-old baby, Lily, was at the end of her hard fight, and we wanted her to be comfortable in her own house. From the initial phone call to the ongoing communication and Dr. Sarnelli showing up and helping us thru the hardest time. Lily absolutely hated car rides and the last thing I could think of is putting her in a car and taking her to a strange place for her final moments. The professionalism and caring that the staff showed thru this time for us and Lily was nothing short of amazing.
